title: Chapter 1360 - 29: Devouring The Chaos Void
content:
Chapter 1360 - 29: Devouring The Chaos Void

Chapter 1360: Chapter 29: Devouring the Chaos Void

"It’s just an imprint, after all, it’s not impossible to get through it..."

Lin Yuan contemplated from the opposite perspective, considering the biggest difference between the imprint and his true self.

It was the inability to use his final card, the World-Breaking Origin Force.

In this way, this imprint of Lin Yuan still had the possibility of being defeated.

That is to preemptively kill.

Based on Lin Yuan’s performance in this cyclic world.

The further it goes, the more terrifying it becomes, especially more than a month before his life limit when he manages to replace the world consciousness.

Lin Yuan in this state is invincible; any number of tribulation passers would perish.

Therefore, to win, one must preemptively kill; if Lin Yuan is not killed within the first ten years,

then it can be declared that the tribulation would not be passed.

"So, does this mean the Emperor of Da Feng is the so-called ’tribulation passer’?"

Through a brief exchange with the Supreme Rule Dao, Lin Yuan also speculated some information.

For instance, the Emperor of Da Feng was different from him; Lin Yuan was trapped in the time loop world to undergo a test.

As for the Emperor of Da Feng, he was undergoing a tribulation, and his calamity was Lin Yuan.

And the test Lin Yuan had to face was the Emperor of Da Feng.

The two could ultimately only have one ’victor.’

If Lin Yuan fails the first time loop and doesn’t kill the emperor before dying of old age,

he would have his memory erased and start the loop again. Then, the Emperor of Da Feng he would face could be just an imprint?

Normally, failing the test the first time, even with memory erased, the second loop would likely yield the same result.

Even though Lin Yuan had the World-Breaking Origin Force as his final card in reserve, he did not want to push the test to the second or third loop.

Who knows what his memory-erased self would think at that time? With countless martial cultivators outside as ’anchor points,’ he could ascertain which cycle he roughly experienced, but it wasn’t too safe.

So if he could pass the test in the first cycle, naturally he should pass in the first cycle.

As for cooperating with the Emperor of Da Feng for a ’win-win’ situation? It’s estimated that the Supreme Rule Dao wouldn’t allow such a thing to happen.

...

"As compensation for replicating my experiences in this cyclic world, the Supreme Rule Dao promised that after I became a time life, I could witness the operation of the Taiyin Origin Dao and Taiyang Origin Dao?"

Lin Yuan felt delighted.

The Supreme Rule Dao, not even the world consciousness, instinctively maintains the balance of endless dimensional planes, not mindlessly replicating a Lin Yuan imprint.

It would give appropriate compensation for the exchange.

And Taiyin and Taiyang Origin Dao belonged to the Dao that time lives of the Thirteenth Stage must comprehend.

The path Lin Yuan was on—the Chaotic Taiji Dao—was self-created, and no endless dimensional plane had a corresponding complete Origin Dao for him to comprehend as a reference.

But as the two foundations of the Chaotic Taiji Dao, Taiyin and Taiyang were manifested in the endless dimensional planes as Taiyin Origin Dao and Taiyang Origin Dao.

Directly observing the operation of these two Origin Daos would be of tremendous assistance for Lin Yuan to break through to the Third Level of Chaotic Taiji Dao, forming the Chaos Taiji Origin Dao.

"I never thought the time loop test could have such benefits."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

However, he also knew, to be actively replicated and recorded by the Supreme Rule Dao as a ’template’ calamity,

the requirements were extremely stringent.

First, it must be calamitous enough to impose great pressure on those ’tribulation passers.’

And in this aspect, Lin Yuan clearly met the criteria.

In the last month or so of his lifetime, when Lin Yuan replaced the world consciousness, he achieved absolute invincibility, making it impossible for any ’tribulation passer’ to rival him, even if hidden at the ends of the Earth.

Secondly, there must be a slim chance of life.

It can’t be too unfathomable.

If Lin Yuan immediately used World-Breaking Origin Force to kill the Emperor of Da Feng upon arriving in the time loop world,

it would be entirely unfathomable for the tribulation passers, with no chance of survival.

Such a scenario would not be actively replicated and recorded by the Supreme Rule Dao.

...

"Tribulation passer? Is this another cultivation system or something else?" Lin Yuan was quite curious about the existence of the Emperor of Da Feng but also understood that this should count as secret information at the Thirteenth Stage level.

Once he stepped into the Thirteenth Stage and became a time life, perhaps he could have some contact?

As the cycle world rapidly disintegrated, Lin Yuan also perceived the true self repressed at the deepest part of the cycle world, or rather suppressed by it.

The so-called falling into a time loop was the true self being suppressed, with a wisp of moral consciousness entering the cycle world.

This was also the reason why the stronger the power, the larger the area formed for the time loop; an insufficiently large time loop could not suppress the corresponding true self.

"The heart returns."

With a subtle thought, the moral consciousness that passed the test instantly merged into his true self.

...

An area exceedingly distant from the Chaos Void.

This is the domain of a Time Lord, a Time Lord of the Twelfth Stage, Third Realm, who consolidates his own timeline. His domain is not limited to space, but extends to the temporal level as well.

A Time Lord’s domain in itself symbolizes a certain deterrence.

Rumbling—In the deepest part of the domain, a massive tentacled creature lay, estimated to be nearly a tenth of the size of the Chaos Void, precisely the Time Lord within this territory.

At this moment, the tentacled creature’s moral consciousness slowly awoke, revealing emotional waves of terror: "The final calamity of ten billion eight thousand tribulations, why is it so arduous?"
